gloss: to serve out portions; to divide up; to set aside

definitions.gloss: to serve out portions; to dish out
definitions.explanation: To take food from a shared dish and divide it into individual portions.

definitions.gloss: to sort out; to separate; to set aside
definitions.explanation: To select and separate specific items from a larger group.

examples.japanese: サラダを{取|と}り{分|わ}けてください。
{大皿|おおざら}の{料理|りょうり}をみんなで{取|と}り{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: We divided up the food from the large platter among everyone.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{分|ぶん}を{先|さき}に{取|と}り{分|わ}けておいた{方|ほう}がいいよ。
examples.english: You should set aside the children's portions first.

examples.japanese: {必要|ひつよう}な{書類|しょるい}を{取|と}り{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: I'll sort out the necessary documents.

examples.japanese: {良|よ}い{品|しな}と{悪|わる}い{品|しな}を{取|と}り{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: I sorted out the good items from the bad ones.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}のために{一部|いちぶ}のサンプルを{取|と}り{分|わ}けて{保管|ほかん}しておく{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It's necessary to set aside and store some samples for testing.

notes:
Most commonly encountered at restaurants and dinner parties when serving food from shared plates. In Japanese dining culture, shared dishes ({大皿|おおざら}{料理|りょうり}) are common, and {取|と}り{分|わ}ける describes the act of portioning food onto individual plates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理|りょうり}を{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to serve out food
- {小皿|こざら}に{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to portion onto small plates
- {均等|きんとう}に{取|と}り{分|わ}ける: to divide equally
- {取|と}り{分|わ}け{用|よう}の{箸|はし}: serving chopsticks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分|わ}ける: to divide; to separate — a more general word for dividing things
- {盛|も}り{付|つ}ける: to plate; to arrange food — focuses on presentation rather than portioning
- {配|くば}る: to distribute; to hand out — implies giving things out to multiple people
